appContext.category: Christian daily devotional discipline with real app blocking (faith-based screen time)
appContext.summary: Regalia is for Christians who want to pray and stand in Scripture before they start scrolling. Each morning it walks them through an eight-minute daily stand that equips the seven pieces of the armour of God from Ephesians 6, with a verse chosen from their mood and a written prayer. Until that session is done, Regalia uses Apple Screen Time to genuinely block the apps they chose to guard, showing a lock gate with a lion, a verse, and their own stated reason. It tracks streaks and keeps an archive of kept verses.
forbiddenInterpretations: secular meditation app with no faith content

theme.style: A reverent pre-dawn world of deep midnight navy and antique gold: cathedral-quiet darkness broken by warm shafts of gilded light, like candle glow on old leather and gold leaf. Textures are soft and material — brushed metal sheen, fine grain, aged parchment warmth, faint volumetric haze — never glossy or techy. Lighting is cinematic and directional, low and still, with calm dark upper regions so headlines read like inscriptions. Backgrounds stay restrained and majestic, letting gold act as the single source of energy.
